Samir —

Thanks for the RFP and the volume note. Quick summary below; I'm attaching a simple workbook with three pilot vs commit scenarios (see evi_compliance_pricing_v1.xlsx). High level:

1) Residency: one-time activation (per-region) + small monthly surcharge per GB for regional egress. For a US-East primary + EU secondary setup we usually recommend: one-time activation fee = $45k (covers VPN/VPC peering + transit config + initial validation). Monthly surcharge = $0.015/GB egress for cross-region reads after retention window. If you commit 12 months and >$40k/mo usage, we can amortize activation to $15k upfront + $2k/mo credit.

2) Audit logs: three retention tiers are priced primarily on storage class. Roughs for your volume (~1.2B tokens/mo -> ~180GB compressed logs/mo): 30d = $0.12/GB/mo; 365d = $0.10/GB/mo; 730d = $0.095/GB/mo. Long-term retention also includes searchable indexing at an incremental $0.03/GB. We can offer an initial pilot discount of 50% off ingestion for the first 3 months.

3) KMS / HSM: two options — Managed KMS (Redwood-managed keys) or Customer HSM seats (FIPS 140-2 validated). Managed KMS: no seat fee, $0.002/operation. HSM seats: $6,000/seat/month for a dedicated HSM (redundant pair recommended); seats provide customer-controlled keys and on-prem integration. Patching/updates are handled by our infra team for managed KMS; for HSM seats we coordinate a maintenance window with your security team and provide an availability SLA (99.95% for key ops) and quarterly attestation.

Commercial flex notes:
- For pilots we typically combine a 3-month ingestion waiver on audit logs + 20% pilot discount on HSM seat pricing (applies to first 90 days).
- For 12-month committed deals we offer amortized activation and an additional 10–20% off monthly surcharges depending on volume banding.

Ben/Aditya — looping you in for the exact numbers and possible concession matrix if Northern wants the HSM seat concession + longer term commit. Samir, I've put the scenario tables in the attached workbook. If you confirm which retention tier you want and whether HSM seats are required for pilot, I can send a redlineable term sheet and a PO guidance doc by Tue EOD.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
